title: Report a problem
intro: Spotted a typo, a mistake or a check that's wrong? Tell us and we'll fix it.

categories.wrong: Something in the explanation is wrong
categories.check: The check rejects my right answer (or accepts a wrong one)
categories.broken: The page or the editor doesn't work

placeholder: Which part, and what did you expect? If it's about the check, paste your code.
public: Reports are posted publicly on GitHub, without your name or email. Please don't include personal details.
thanksText: Your report is in. We'll take a look and fix it.

errors.invalid: Please write a few words about what's wrong.
errors.rate-limited: That's a lot of reports in a short time. Please try again in an hour.
errors.failed: The report couldn't be sent. Please try again in a minute.
